description: A package whose module-level flag only its own timer's callback clears (`running`, until the queued work runs), on jest-environment-jsdom with one worker. `leaves-work` is the larger file, so it runs first: its test queues work and ends before the timer fires. `runs-work` queues work and waits for it. Jest passes both: each file evaluates the package again, so the second file's copy has its own flag.
